title: Application and Petition of the Commonwealth Electric Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell up to 437,500 shares of common capital stock, $25 par value, at no less than par; to issue and sell on a negotiated basis, additional long-term notes in the aggregate principal amount of up to $65,000,000; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. c. 164 , § 15; for an exemption from the par value requirements for long-term debt securities of G.L. c. 164, § 15A.
